name: portable-computer-use
description: Cross-platform computer use for Claude Code: accessibility trees, window screenshots, clicks and typing on macOS, Windows and Linux. Bundles an Agent Skill, a stdio MCP server and the native helper.

timeout_ms.title: Default timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: Deadline in milliseconds for the native helper and JavaScript runtime. Raise it for apps with large accessibility trees (WeCom needs about 120000).
